name: 等待事件分析诊断
description: events_waits_summary_global_by_event_name 是 MySQL 等待事件分析的核心视图，类似 Oracle 的 V$SYSTEM_EVENT。它记录了所有等待事件的累计次数和总耗时。常见等待类型：wait/io/file/（文件 IO 等待）、wait/io/table/（表 IO 等待）、wait/lock/（锁等待）、wait/synch/mutex/（互斥锁等待）、wait/synch/rwlock/（读写锁等待）。通过分析等待事件的分布可以快速定位系统瓶颈在 IO、锁、还是 CPU。

signals.desc: IO 等待占总等待的比例高
单个等待事件占比过高

conditions.desc: TOP1 等待事件占总等待时间 > 50%

skip_when.desc: 实例空闲时 idle 等待占比高是正常的

root_causes.name: IO 等待占比高 — 磁盘瓶颈
root_causes.desc: wait/io/file/innodb/ 等待时间长表示 InnoDB 数据文件或日志文件的磁盘 IO 成为瓶颈。可能是 buffer pool 命中率低、redo log 写入慢、或底层磁盘性能不足。

root_causes.name: 锁等待占比高 — 并发竞争
root_causes.desc: wait/lock/ 等待时间长表示行锁或表锁竞争严重。需要结合 data_locks/innodb_lock_waits 进一步分析具体锁类型和涉及的 SQL。

root_causes.name: Mutex 等待占比高 — 内部竞争
root_causes.desc: wait/synch/mutex/ 等待高表示 MySQL 内部结构竞争：buf_pool_mutex（buffer pool）、LOCK_open（表缓存）、trx_sys_mutex（事务系统）等。通常需要调整相关配置或升级版本。

root_causes.name: wait instruments 不足导致盲区
root_causes.desc: 关键的 wait instruments 未启用，导致无法看到真实的等待分布。比如 wait/io/file 关闭了就看不到 IO 等待。

step1_top_waits.desc: TOP 等待事件（按总等待时间排序）
step1_top_waits.sql: SELECT EVENT_NAME, COUNT_STAR AS wait_count, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT/1e12, 2) AS total_sec, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT/1e9, 2) AS avg_ms, ROUND(MAX_TIMER_WAIT/1e9, 2) AS max_ms FROM performance_schema.events_waits_summary_global_by_event_name WHERE EVENT_NAME != 'idle' AND COUNT_STAR > 0 ORDER BY SUM_TIMER_WAIT DESC LIMIT 20

step2_wait_by_category.sql: SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(EVENT_NAME, '/', 3) AS category, COUNT(*) AS event_types, SUM(COUNT_STAR) AS total_count, ROUND(SUM(SUM_TIMER_WAIT)/1e12, 2) AS total_sec FROM performance_schema.events_waits_summary_global_by_event_name WHERE EVENT_NAME != 'idle' AND COUNT_STAR > 0 GROUP BY category ORDER BY total_sec DESC LIMIT 15

step3_io_waits_detail.sql: SELECT EVENT_NAME, COUNT_STAR, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT/1e12, 2) AS total_sec, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT/1e9, 2) AS avg_ms FROM performance_schema.events_waits_summary_global_by_event_name WHERE EVENT_NAME LIKE 'wait/io/%' AND COUNT_STAR > 0 ORDER BY SUM_TIMER_WAIT DESC LIMIT 10

step4_lock_waits_detail.sql: SELECT EVENT_NAME, COUNT_STAR, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT/1e12, 2) AS total_sec, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT/1e9, 2) AS avg_ms FROM performance_schema.events_waits_summary_global_by_event_name WHERE EVENT_NAME LIKE 'wait/lock/%' AND COUNT_STAR > 0 ORDER BY SUM_TIMER_WAIT DESC LIMIT 10

step5_mutex_waits_detail.sql: SELECT EVENT_NAME, COUNT_STAR, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT/1e12, 2) AS total_sec, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT/1e9, 2) AS avg_ms FROM performance_schema.events_waits_summary_global_by_event_name WHERE EVENT_NAME LIKE 'wait/synch/mutex/%' AND COUNT_STAR > 0 ORDER BY SUM_TIMER_WAIT DESC LIMIT 10

step6_wait_instruments_status.desc: 检查 wait instruments 启用状态
step6_wait_instruments_status.sql: SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(NAME, '/', 3) AS category, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(ENABLED='YES') AS enabled FROM performance_schema.setup_instruments WHERE NAME LIKE 'wait/%' GROUP BY category

real_world_examples.scenario: 数据库 CPU 正常但查询延迟高，通过等待事件发现 IO 瓶颈
real_world_examples.symptoms: 查询 P99 延迟从 10ms 涨到 80ms，但 CPU 使用率只有 30%。DBA 一直在优化 SQL 但没效果
real_world_examples.root_cause: 通过 events_waits_summary 发现 wait/io/file/innodb/innodb_data_file 占总等待的 72%。进一步发现 Buffer Pool 命中率只有 96%（原来是 99.5%）。原来是新上线的报表功能导致工作集膨胀
real_world_examples.resolution: buffer pool 从 16GB 扩到 32GB，同时将报表查询路由到从库
real_world_examples.result: IO 等待占比从 72% 降到 15%，P99 延迟恢复到 12ms
